d: A heartfelt and soulful song from the film Khilona (1970), "Khush Rahe Tu Sadaa Ye Duaa Hai Meri” beautifully captures the warmth, love, and excitement of wishing someone happiness in their journey of love and marriage. Sung by the legendary Mohammed Rafi, with enchanting music by Laxmikant–Pyarelal and heartfelt lyrics by Anand Bakshi, this song brings together emotions of joy, hope, and tender affection. The performances of Sanjeev Kumar, Mumtaz, Jeetendra, and Shatrughan Sinha add an extra layer of charm and sincerity, making it a timeless classic that celebrates love, blessings, and…
